stem: What happens next in this passage after “Then she realized she had not discovered anything surprising for weeks.”?
options: A music festival asked visitors not to record the first three songs.
Finally, the music teacher asked each group to explain why their song fit the class.
It helped them see that everyone had different things to care about.
She searched for music from different countries and asked friends for recommendations.
